data.title: Comparing Four-Digit Numbers by Place Value
data.subject: Arithmetic

problem.statement: Let us compare two 4-digit numbers: 2,989 and 3,012. First, let us look at the thousands place of each number directly. The number 2,989 has a thousands digit of 2, while the number 3,012 has a thousands digit of 3. Even though 2,989 has high digits like 8 and 9 in the other places, and even if we add 1 to 999 to understand place value transitions, the thousands place comes first. Since 3 is greater than 2, the number 3,012 is greater than 2,989. Value in smaller places does not override the largest place. Therefore, 2,989 < 3,012.
